gate_shape.note: typecheck and build each independently build shared -> mina-zkapp first, then run --workspaces --if-present; this hand-ordering is intentional (project references must resolve before the rest of the workspaces typecheck/build), not duplicated work to fix.

method: Two independent measurements against the same commit (cb4f27b, HEAD of main at capture time). (1) Local: ran the 4 gate commands sequentially in a fresh sandbox (npm ci, then build -> lint -> typecheck -> test, matching CLAUDE.md's documented gate order), timing each with `time`. (2) CI: read actual GitHub Actions job timestamps and logs for the equivalent jobs (Lint and Format Check, TypeScript Type Check, Build All Packages, Test Node 22.x, Test Node 22.12.0) via `gh run view <id> --json jobs` and `gh run view <id> --log`, spot-checked against a second recent main-branch run. Reproduce locally with: `npm ci && npm install @libsql/linux-x64-gnu --no-save && npm run build && npm run lint --workspaces --if-present && npm run typecheck && NODE_OPTIONS='--max-old-space-size=8192' npm run test --workspaces --if-present`.

local_sequential.note: test run with NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=8192 --runInBand-equivalent workspace ordering per CLAUDE.md; the mina-zkapp jest suite (WASM/o1js proof compilation) is the dominant cost inside `test` (433.8s of the 591.7s).

ci_parallel_jobs.note: CI runs these 5 jobs concurrently on separate runners; the gate as experienced by a PR author is bounded by the slowest job (Test Node 22.12.0 at 772s / 12m52s), not their sum. full_ci_workflow_wall_clock is the whole CI workflow (includes non-gate jobs: security audit, container scan, Docker integration suites) and is provided for context only, not as the gate number.

runner_minutes.note: connector is a public repo, so GitHub Actions minutes are unmetered/free; `gh api .../actions/runs/<id>/timing` reports billable.UBUNTU.total_ms as 0 for every job. As a cost proxy (not a bill), summing the 5 gate jobs' wall-clock on the captured run gives ~28 runner-minutes (61+52+59+753+772 = 1697s).

docker_image_size.note: Not captured this pass -- no docker binary available in the capture sandbox. Reproduce with `npx --yes @ai-hero/sandcastle@0.12.0 docker build-image && docker images sandcastle:connector --format '{{.Size}}'` (mirrors .github/workflows/agent-image.yml, which builds .sandcastle/Dockerfile but does not report size). A follow-up performance-tuning child should capture this before attempting to shrink the image.

cache_hit_rate.method: Grepped each gate job's Setup Node.js step for 'Cache hit for:' vs 'Cache not found' in `gh run view 29953913670 --log`, across the 5 gate-relevant jobs (Lint and Format Check, Build All Packages, TypeScript Type Check, Test Node 22.x, Test Node 22.12.0). All 5 hit the `node-cache-Linux-x64-npm-*` key (actions/setup-node's npm cache, keyed on package-lock.json). Spot-checked run 29951695547 (commit c86dee0) shows the same job-timing pattern, consistent with a warm cache.

gate_correctness.method: Ran the full gate locally against commit cb4f27b (HEAD of main): `npm run lint --workspaces --if-present`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm run test --workspaces --if-present` (after `npm run build`). Lint error/warning counts cross-checked per workspace with `npx eslint src --ext .ts -f json`.

no_false_pass_holes.note: connector already has 0 lint and 0 typecheck debt (confirmed above), so unlike toon-client (82 tsc errors) or toon (940 lint warnings) there is no existing violation set to freeze as an allowlist. The correctness-hardening follow-up child for this repo is 'add a no-regression guard' only, not a baseline-freeze.

no_false_fail_flakiness.note: Single-run capture; flakiness (no-false-FAIL) requires repeated runs to detect and is out of scope for this capture-baseline child. Track in a follow-up correctness child per the epic's per-repo pattern.
